Notice of Enquiry

Date: {{ frappe.utils.format_date(doc.issue_reported_to_hr, "dd-MMM-yyyy") }}

Employee Name: {{ doc.employee_name }}

Employee ID: {{ doc.employee_id }}

Designation: {{ doc.designation }}

Branch Name: {{ doc.branch_name }}

With reference to the Show Cause Notice dated {{ frappe.utils.format_date(doc.issue_reported_to_hr, "dd-MMM-yyyy") }}, we have {% if doc.status_of_response == "Satisfactory" %}received your explanation{% else %}not received your explanation{% endif %}. {% if doc.status_of_response != "Satisfactory" %}However, your explanation is not satisfactory and Management has decided to conduct an Internal Enquiry on the alleged charges mentioned in the Show Cause Notice served on you dated {{ frappe.utils.format_date(doc.issue_date_report_to_hr, "dd-MMM-yyyy") }}.{% endif %}

In view of the above, {{ doc.enquiry_officer_name }} has been appointed as the Enquiry Officer and will conduct an Enquiry on {{ frappe.utils.format_date(doc.date_of_enquiry, "dd-MMM-yyyy") }} at {{ doc.place_of_enquiry }}.

You are requested to attend the enquiry as per the above and present your version, supporting with evidence if any. Further, you will be provided all opportunity to prove your case during the enquiry.

If you fail to be present during the enquiry, the Enquiry Officer will proceed further in the matter on the basis of the evidence and records available in the case.

For Sahayog Multistate Credit Cooperative Society

{% set ex_stamp = frappe.db.get_single_value("Sahayog HR Setting", "domestic_enquiry_stamp") %} {% if ex_stamp %} {% endif %} Authorized Signatory
